## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and what this PR changes for a user or contributor.

## Related requirements and issues

Reference requirement IDs and an issue, if applicable.

## Validation

List the exact checks or commands run and their results. State what was not run and why. For documentation-only work, include link/language/consistency checks.

## Compatibility and limitations

Identify affected source versions, data contracts, permissions, migrations, or deployment assumptions. Distinguish planned behavior from implemented behavior.

## Contributor review

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff, including any agent-generated work.
- [ ] Openflow-owned content is in English.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated datasets, or nested upstream checkouts are included.
- [ ] The change has a focused scope and meaningful acceptance criteria.
